[[File:Feynman diagram.jpg|thumbnail|This Feynman diagram describes the weak nuclear interaction between an electron and a neutrino via the exchange of a virtual $Z^0$ boson]]

Invented by American physicist [[Person:Richard Feynman|Richard Feynman]] (1918–1988), a '''Feynman diagram''' describes how [[quantum particles]] move and interact in [[spacetime]].<ref>{{#cite:Q2545}}</ref>
